facts.text: Traditional residential students at Warner University are required to earn 21 Spiritual Growth credits each semester, including attending 10 in-person chapel services.

sources.title: Spiritual Growth Requirements - Warner University
sources.quote: Spiritual Growth credits are a requirement for all traditional students. Students who accept enrollment at Warner University agree to the completion of Spiritual Growth credits each semester.

sources.title: Spiritual Growth Requirements - Warner University
sources.quote: Residential students must meet their 10 in-person chapel requirement and 11 other credits through Spiritual Growth Opportunities (SGOs) offered throughout the semester or a Core Community.
